identity.name: Heart Outside Time
identity.summary: A dark red heart in an open square gold clock frame.
identity.description: Adds 3 maximum mana, refreshed each round. Adds 2 maximum stamina, refreshed each round. Supplies 4 ward each round against poison, curse and reflected damage.
identity.lore: It beats between the moments measured by every other clock.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.
